data.exact_reserve_text: This book has performed well and it has again been possible to release reserves from prior years. The EL/PL book was profitable in 2018 benefitting from reserve releases from prior years. Reserves established in 2017 in respect of Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria have proved to be adequate with development of reported losses in line with expectations.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2018 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (1 Jan 2018) was GBP 1,015.305m. Based on the gross claims development triangle the syndicate reports a small net prior-year release of approximately GBP 4.6m (c.0.45% of opening gross reserves), driven by favourable claims development notably in casualty and EL/PL lines and reserve releases from prior years. These releases were partially offset by current-year catastrophe losses (hurricanes, typhoons and Californian wildfires) which the report states were within modelled expectations. The syndicate also absorbed a reinsurance-to-close (Syndicate 2255) in January 2018 which is a one-off structural item noted in the report.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development derived from the gross claims development triangle (calculation excludes the '2010 and prior' aggregate column as required). The syndicate executed a reinsurance-to-close (Syndicate 2255) as at 1 January 2018 which added reserves/premiums and may distort year-on-year comparisons. Narrative statements reference reserve releases (net of reinsurance) for some books; a gross movement note was not separately labelled - triangle was used as primary source.
